description: Known bug patterns in open-source LLM API translators for `convpreserve explain`.
scope: Observed on pinned open-source translator releases; newer versions may already include fixes.

S03.cause: The converter that turns a tool result into the target message never reads is_error: the target tool message is built from role, tool_call_id and content only (litellm, claude-code-proxy, llm-rosetta, claude-code-router), or the Gemini function response is built from the output without telling error text from text (Vercel AI SDK). On the Vercel AI SDK OpenAI exits an output of type error-text is written exactly like text.

S04.cause: A tool result given as a list of content blocks is converted to Google parts and embedded as functionResponse.response.output, a JSON list of {text: ...} objects, instead of the text itself.
On the legacy tool-result path (Gemini model names without function-response parts) a list result is written as one functionResponse per text part, with the same id repeated, instead of one response.

S05.cause: On the legacy tool-result path (Gemini model names without function-response parts) a list result is written as one functionResponse per text part, with the same id repeated, instead of one response.

No handler exists for redacted_thinking blocks: llm-rosetta's ingress part dispatcher returns no part for any block type other than text, image, document, tool_use, tool_result and thinking; claude-code-router's ingress reads only thinking blocks that carry a signature; the Vercel AI SDK modules never mention redactedData. The block is dropped before a target converter runs.
A user message that contains tool_result blocks is consumed whole by the tool-result converter, which emits only the tool results; the text blocks of the same message are never emitted.

S06.cause: On the legacy tool-result path (Gemini model names without function-response parts) a list result is written as one functionResponse per text part, with the same id repeated, instead of one response.
functionCall parts carry an id, but functionResponse parts are built from name and response only (no id key), so a Gemini function response cannot be matched to its call by id.

Responses are re-emitted in the order of the model's tool calls, each paired with its call by an id lookup, and written without ids; a reader that pairs by position sees a different name order than the source.

S07.cause: Assistant text that followed a tool call ends up before it: claude-code-router joins all assistant text blocks into one string and emits the text part before the functionCall parts; the Vercel AI SDK Anthropic provider passes assistant content through moveToolUseBlocksToEnd.

S08.cause: generationConfig is built with thinkingConfig only; request.max_tokens is never copied into it.

The request builder forwards a fixed list of optional parameters that does not include top_k (claude-code-proxy: stop_sequences and top_p only; claude-code-router: the unified request carries no top_k). llm-rosetta and Vercel AI SDK drop it with a runtime warning, i.e. as a declared degradation.

claude-code-router's unified request carries no top_p. The Vercel AI SDK Anthropic provider deletes top_p with a warning when temperature is also set; this is declared at runtime and in the SDK documentation.
stop_sequences is never read at the Anthropic ingress: the unified request carries only messages, model, max_tokens, temperature, stream, tools and tool_choice.

The request-level metadata block (metadata.user_id) is never read: claude-code-proxy builds the body from model, messages, max_tokens, temperature, stream (plus stop, top_p); llm-rosetta builds its intermediate request from system, messages, tools, tool_choice, config, reasoning and stream; claude-code-router's unified request has no metadata.

The tool_choice handler maps only type and name; disable_parallel_tool_use is never read and no parallel_tool_calls is set (litellm, claude-code-proxy, claude-code-router). llm-rosetta's Google tool-config converter returns an empty config, documented as having no direct mapping.
The request model defaults temperature to 1.0 when the client sent none, and the defaulted value is always forwarded.

tool_choice type any has no equivalent branch: claude-code-proxy maps it to auto; claude-code-router passes it through as a string and its Gemini egress branches on auto, none, required and function name only, so any yields functionCallingConfig {} (no mode).

A forced tool_choice {type: tool, name} passes the name through the same truncate_tool_name rewrite as the tool list, so it changes only when the declared tool name is rewritten (dependent on tool_name_rewritten).

S09.cause: Tool names longer than 64 characters are replaced by a 55-character prefix, an underscore and 8 hex characters of a SHA-256 of the name, for every tool in the request; the library keeps a mapping table to restore the name.
